purpose: Canonical visual vocabulary for ECL dossier governance-context rendering.

accessibility.rule: Color MUST NOT be the sole carrier of meaning. Render the state letter and text label with every color.
accessibility.contrast: SVG status cards use dark text on light surfaces and include explicit letter/label text.

semanticBoundary: Palette colors communicate the referenced governance state only. They never imply culpability, participation, hierarchy, or inheritance by a non-State entity.
